semiconductor_relevance: High — Light Trace Photonics develops innovative interconnect solutions that are critical for the integration of optics in semiconductor packaging.
summary: Light Trace Photonics is a deep-tech start-up specializing in the Universal Photonic Interconnect (UPIc), which enables ultra-high-performance fiber-chip interconnects for co-packaged optics and pluggable transceiver applications. Their technology addresses key challenges in fiber attachment, enhancing manufacturability and serviceability for AI data centers and hyperscale environments.
capabilities: Detachable fiber-chip connections with low loss
Passive alignment solutions for rapid assembly

regional_presence.United Kingdom: The company is based in Bristol, focusing on developing its technology for the semiconductor industry.
